desc: Modern ice cream parlour chain serving frozen desserts including kulfi, faluda & sundaes.
addr: 39, 80 Feet Rd, next to Decathlon, Hal, HAL 3rd Stage, Raman Nagar, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560075, India

rev.t: ​This is my absolute go-to ice cream parlor! Since it's right near my place, I visit all the time. They offer a massive variety of flavors that are incredibly budget-friendly. But the absolute best part? They have a swing! It’s the perfect …

Stay away from this shop. Zero transparency. The employees have no idea what they are selling. Menu had brownie sundae mini. The guy says has it. After eating, during payment, they say there is no mini and charge you 300rs. Avoid this place. The employees are clueless about everything.

The ice cream flavours are good. We tried their chocolate whisky, pista and chocolate hazelnut ice creams. Many of the flavours we asked were not available but the staff suggested these flavours to us. The staff is very friendly and they would recommend some of the best ice creams to try.
